make_video_from_observations: build a video from a list of sensor observations with optional overlay images and custom fps
observation_to_image_convert: convert a raw sensor observation array to a PIL Image for color, depth, or semantic types
depth_to_rgb_normalize: normalize a depth image array into a clipped grayscale RGB numpy array
semantic_to_rgb_map: map semantic segmentation IDs to colored RGB values and return an RGBA PIL Image
get_island_colored_map: generate a colored top-down island map image from Pathfinder island index data
